phase_policy.purpose: Final Phase-1 validation. No additional Phase-1 architecture or controller experiments after reveal.
phase_policy.next_step_after_reveal: Close Phase 1 and move to Phase 2 regardless of outcome; record any limitation without tuning on CR9114-H1.

dataset.name: CR9114-H1 combinatorial antibody binding-affinity landscape
dataset.external_background: Complete 16-site combinatorial CR9114 landscape; published work reports strong third- through fifth-order epistasis for H1 binding.

candidate_scope.reason: Directly test higher-order candidate ranking and active acquisition in natural 4- and 5-mutation genotypes while retaining lower-order evidence for memory construction.

sealed_split.training_pool: mutation_count in {1,2,3,4,5} AND FNV1a32(candidate_id) mod 10 in {0,1,2,3,4,5,6}
sealed_split.hidden_test: mutation_count in {4,5} AND FNV1a32(candidate_id) mod 10 in {7,8,9}

higher_order_qualification_before_reveal.action_if_failed: ABORT BEFORE REVEAL; CR9114-H1 does not count as the intended higher-order/controller final gate.

fixed_candidate_pool.definition: Intersection of hidden 4/5-mutant candidates scoreable by passive 5%, all passive budgets, and all active budgets.

primary_metrics: Top-50 count of true hidden Top-1% variants

active_controller_gate.question: Can Active 10% or Active 20% reach the frozen Passive 40% V8.3 practical threshold?

negative_controls: passive-40 shuffled-label V8.3 through identical router

anti_leakage.stage_0: Package training-pool labels, hidden 4/5 identities, and sealed hidden truth; never print hidden fitness values.
anti_leakage.stage_A: Run passive budgets and frozen active controller, freeze common hidden pool, router modes, acquisition selections, predictions, Top-10/Top-50 rankings, controls and hashes without hidden truth.
anti_leakage.stage_B: Verify every Stage-A hash and frozen ranking first, then load hidden truth exactly once and compute the final gate.
